meta.description: Axiom skill DAG: 5 pillars, prerequisite edges, per-node BKT priors, archetype coverage.
meta.notes: tier selects the BKT preset; see docs/research/pedagogy.md §2 for justification.

nodes.title: Double-Entry & the Accounting Equation
nodes.summary: Debits, credits, normal balances, and why Assets = Liabilities + Equity holds after every journal entry.

nodes.title: Three-Statement Linkage
nodes.summary: How the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement tie together: net income to retained earnings, cash flow to cash balance, non-cash items.
mental_models: cash is a balance sheet account

nodes.title: Accrual vs. Cash Dynamics
nodes.summary: Timing differences between economic activity and cash: deferred revenue, prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, and the accrual ratio.

nodes.title: Revenue Recognition & Cutoff
nodes.summary: ASC 606 five-step model, cutoff at period end, shipping terms, bill-and-hold, right of return and channel inventory.
mental_models: returns reserve as a leading indicator

nodes.title: Working Capital & the Cash Conversion Cycle
nodes.summary: DSO, DIO, DPO, cash conversion cycle, and how growth consumes cash even when a company is profitable.
mental_models: stretching payables is borrowing from suppliers

nodes.title: Activity-Based vs. Volume Cost Allocation
nodes.summary: Cost pools, cost drivers, and how volume-based overhead allocation subsidises complex low-volume products.

nodes.title: Variance Analysis: Price / Volume / Mix
nodes.summary: Decomposing margin change into price, volume, mix and cost variances; flexible budgets.
mental_models: hold one thing constant at a time

nodes.title: Ratio & Common-Size Analysis
nodes.summary: Liquidity, leverage, efficiency and profitability ratios; common-size statements; trend and peer comparison.
mental_models: ratios are only meaningful in context

nodes.title: Sub-Ledger to General Ledger Tie-Out
nodes.summary: Reconciling AR, AP, inventory and revenue sub-ledgers to GL control accounts; classifying and ageing differences.
mental_models: age the break, don't plug it

nodes.title: DCF & Capital Budgeting
nodes.summary: Free cash flow derivation, WACC, NPV/IRR, terminal value and sensitivity analysis.
mental_models: value is discounted cash, not earnings

nodes.title: 13-Week Cash Flow & Liquidity Forecasting
nodes.summary: Direct-method short-term cash forecasting, receipts/disbursements timing, minimum cash and runway.
mental_models: direct method for the short run

nodes.title: Debt Covenants & Liquidity Risk
nodes.summary: Maintenance vs. incurrence covenants, leverage and coverage tests, headroom and cure rights.

nodes.title: Forensic Anomaly Detection
nodes.summary: Beneish M-score, Sloan accruals, Benford's law, journal-entry red flags and the standard financial shenanigans catalogue.
mental_models: red flags cluster at period end

nodes.title: M&A Valuation, Synergies & Accretion
nodes.summary: Standalone vs. pro-forma value, cost and revenue synergies, integration costs, accretion/dilution and purchase accounting.
mental_models: pay for the standalone, not the synergy
integration cost is a synergy tax

nodes.title: Process Flow, Throughput & Capacity
nodes.summary: Mapping a process into stations, measuring throughput, cycle time, utilization and work-in-process.

nodes.title: Little's Law
nodes.summary: L = lambda x W and its uses: inventory from throughput and flow time, backlog from arrival rate and wait.

nodes.title: Queueing & Variability
nodes.summary: M/M/1 behaviour, the utilization hockey stick, Kingman's formula and why variability at high utilization explodes wait time.

nodes.title: Theory of Constraints & Bottleneck Migration
nodes.summary: Goldratt's five focusing steps, drum-buffer-rope, and how relieving one constraint moves it elsewhere.
mental_models: an hour lost at the bottleneck is lost forever

nodes.title: Inventory: EOQ, Safety Stock, Service Level
nodes.summary: EOQ trade-off, reorder points, safety stock from demand and lead-time variability, fill rate vs. cycle service level.
mental_models: safety stock scales with sigma x sqrt(L)
service level is a cost decision
EOQ is flat near the optimum

nodes.title: The Bullwhip Effect
nodes.summary: Demand-signal amplification up the supply chain from order batching, forecast updating, price promotions and rationing.

nodes.title: Unit Economics
nodes.summary: Contribution margin, CAC, LTV, payback period and how they roll up to the P&L.

nodes.title: Cohort Retention & Net Revenue Retention
nodes.summary: Logo vs. revenue retention, cohort curves, NRR decomposition into expansion/contraction/churn, survivorship bias.

nodes.title: Pricing Power & Elasticity
nodes.summary: Price elasticity of demand, price ladders, discounting leakage, willingness-to-pay segmentation.

nodes.title: Competitive Moats & Positioning
nodes.summary: Switching costs, network effects, scale economies, brand and regulatory moats; how moats show up in retention and margin.

nodes.title: M&A Synergy Identification & Integration
nodes.summary: Separating real cost and revenue synergies from hope, integration sequencing, and dis-synergies.

nodes.title: Decisions & Allocation Under Uncertainty
nodes.summary: Expected value, scenario analysis, option value, portfolio allocation and the cost of being wrong in each direction.

nodes.title: Capacity Planning & Resource Allocation
nodes.summary: Sizing capacity against uncertain demand, lead-time of capacity additions, and sequencing investments.

nodes.title: Data Modeling & Normalization
nodes.summary: Entities, keys, normal forms, and the trade-offs of denormalization.

nodes.title: OLTP vs. OLAP & Read Replicas

nodes.title: Idempotency & At-Least-Once Delivery

nodes.title: Event-Driven Architecture

nodes.title: Replication, Lag & Consistency Models

nodes.title: Caching Strategies

nodes.title: Rate Limiting & Backpressure

nodes.title: Failure-Mode Analysis
nodes.summary: FMEA for systems: timeouts, retries, partial failure, blast radius and circuit breakers.

nodes.title: Observability & Diagnosis
nodes.summary: Metrics, logs, traces, SLOs and how to find a silent failure from the data it leaves behind.

nodes.title: Architecture Failures as P&L Lines
nodes.summary: Translating duplicate charges, lost events and stale reads into refunds, chargebacks, unbilled revenue and oversold inventory.

nodes.title: SELECT, Filtering & Aggregation
nodes.summary: Projections, predicates, GROUP BY / HAVING, conditional aggregation and NULL semantics.

nodes.title: Joins & Fan-Out Traps

nodes.title: Recursive CTEs

nodes.title: Temporal Cohort Analysis
nodes.summary: Building cohort-by-period matrices, retention triangles and survival from event tables.

nodes.title: Reconciliation Queries
nodes.summary: Full-outer-join tie-outs, sub-ledger vs. GL comparisons, tolerance matching and break classification.

nodes.summary: Cumulative sums for ledger balances, roll-forwards, and period-over-period deltas.

nodes.summary: Split-apply-combine, pivot/melt, time resampling and rolling windows.

nodes.title: Hypothesis Testing & Confidence Intervals
nodes.summary: t-tests, chi-square, bootstrap CIs, power and multiple-comparison awareness.

nodes.title: Time Series & Forecasting

nodes.summary: Building linked statements, DCFs and scenario tables programmatically with explicit assumptions.

nodes.title: API Ingestion & Idempotent Loads

nodes.summary: Cohort matrices, retention curves, Kaplan-Meier style survival and LTV from retention.
